item.subject: science
item.stem:
Arjun built the loop shown below: one cell, a lamp, an ammeter, and a variable resistor. He wants a circuit diagram of the same loop using standard symbols such as a long line and a short line for the cell, a circle with a cross for the lamp, and a circle marked A for the ammeter.

Which statement about that diagram is correct?

options.A: The lamp may be drawn as any neat sketch of a bulb, because a circuit diagram is just a tidy picture of the parts.
options.B: Each part must use its standard symbol: the cell as a long line and a short line, the lamp as a circle with a cross, and the ammeter as a circle marked A.
options.C: The cell should be drawn with two separate lamp branches leaving it, so both the lamp and the ammeter get their own loop.
options.D: The long and short lines of the cell may be drawn either way round, because the direction of the cell does not matter in a diagram.
